violation.draw: No draws: this tournament requires a winner.
violation.exceeds: Impossible score in {label}: {max} maps at most, and never more than {wins} per team.
violation.below: Incomplete score in {label}: the winner must reach {wins, plural, one {# map} other {# maps}}.

blocker.draw: The scores can't be equal: there must be a winner.
blocker.doubleForfeit: A double forfeit decides the match: it's entered with “Confirm the result”.
blocker.notInLaunch: The score can be entered once the match is launched. Before that, only a forfeit can be ruled.
blocker.alreadyDecided: This match is already decided. Correct it with “Confirm the result” so the winner and the rest of the board follow.

maps.replayHintOverwatch: Overwatch replay code: 6 characters (letters and digits).
maps.replayHintOther: Game code or ID: 4 to 32 characters (letters, digits, hyphens).
maps.replayAllowance: A drawn map can be replayed ({count} at most).
maps.drawHint: A drawn map gives a point to no one.

violation.empty: Add at least one played map.
violation.tooMany: Too many maps: {max} at most for this match.
violation.codeRequired: Replay code missing for this map.
violation.codeDuplicate: This replay code is already on another map.
violation.scoreInvalid: Map score missing or invalid: a whole number between 0 and {max} (0 – 0 for a drawn map).
violation.afterDecision: This map comes after the end of the match: the result was already settled.
violation.incomplete: Unfinished match: without a winner, all {max} maps are played (a drawn map counts as one).
violation.tooManyWon: Too many maps won for the match format.
violation.below: Incomplete score: the winner must win {wins, plural, one {# map} other {# maps}}.

admin.title: Match score
admin.saved: Score saved: the match is still in progress.
admin.resolved: Result confirmed: the board is up to date.
admin.awaitingDetail: Loading the proposed map details… Refresh the page if they don't arrive.
admin.proposal: Score proposed by {author} ({score1} – {score2}), awaiting confirmation from {other}. Check it, then confirm the result to approve it.
admin.proposalDirty: Score proposed by {author} ({score1} – {score2}), awaiting confirmation from {other}. Your entry replaces it.

stored.doubleForfeit: Double forfeit recorded: {team1} and {team2} both lose.

admin.closedToPlan: Match to schedule: set its date before entering the score. A forfeit can be ruled right now.
admin.closedWaiting: Match waiting to start: the score can be entered once it's launched. A forfeit can be ruled right now.
admin.conflict: This match changed while you were entering it — someone else saved a result. Sending now would overwrite theirs.
admin.derivedHint: Score calculated from the maps below: remove every map to enter it by hand.

forfeit.open: Declare a forfeit on this round
forfeit.double: {team1} and {team2} both forfeit: the match is lost for both, no one advances, and in a bracket their next opponent gets a bye.
forfeit.single: {out} forfeits this round: {through} wins {maps}-0, with no map played.
forfeit.question: Who forfeits this round? Their opponent wins {maps}-0, and any entered scores are ignored.
forfeit.questionClosed: Who forfeits this round? Their opponent wins {maps}-0.

admin.saveTitle: Records progress without naming a winner.
admin.resolveTitle: Names the winner and updates the board.

correction.title: Correct a result that's already confirmed?
correction.replaced: This published result will be replaced by the new entry.
correction.consequences: If the outcome changes, whatever followed from it is undone: a next match with no score yet may change opponent (keeping its time), the standings are recalculated, and an already finished tournament goes back to in progress.

player.title: My match score
player.conflictMaps: Same score ({score}), but the map details differ from {opponent}'s: replay codes or map scores. The referee has been alerted; you can still correct your proposal.
player.conflictScores: The scores contradict each other — you: {mine}, {opponent}: {theirs}. The referee has been alerted; you can still correct your proposal.

closed.toPlan: This match is waiting for the referee to set its date: the score can be entered once the match is launched.
closed.scheduledAt: This match starts on {date}: the score can be entered once it's launched, when the parties have declared themselves ready.
closed.scheduled: This match hasn't started yet: the score can be entered once it's launched, when the parties have declared themselves ready.
closed.lobby: The score can be entered once the match is launched: every party must have declared itself ready.

theirs.readOnly: {opponent} proposes {score}. Waiting for confirmation from someone in charge of {mine}.
theirs.withMaps: {opponent} proposes {score}. Confirm it, or enter the score you saw: a disagreement alerts the referee.
theirs.loading: {opponent} proposes {score}. Loading their map details… Refresh the page if they don't arrive.
theirs.withoutMaps: {opponent} proposes {score}, without the map details. To confirm it, enter the maps played and their replay codes: a disagreement alerts the referee.

player.minePending: You proposed {score}. Waiting for {opponent} to confirm.
player.minePendingDeadline: You proposed {score}. Waiting for {opponent} to confirm — with no answer, this score will be confirmed at {deadline}.
player.willConfirm: {opponent} will have to confirm the score you send.

forfeit.open: Declare a forfeit on this match
forfeit.hint: {mine} forfeits this match: {opponent} wins {maps}-0, with no map played. The result is immediate — only the referee can reverse it.
forfeit.notAllowed: A forfeit is declared by the team's owner or a manager.

refusal.incomplete: Incomplete date: pick the day and the month, or clear both to announce no time.
refusal.invalid: This day doesn't exist in this month.

schedule.pendingInvalid: No possible date: this day doesn't exist in this month.
schedule.hintPlanning: The match stays “Waiting to start” until that time, then moves into launch: both teams declare themselves ready.
schedule.hint: No day and no month = no time announced. At the set time, the match moves into launch: both teams declare themselves ready.
schedule.title: Match start date
schedule.warnLive: This match goes on air at its start date: without a date, it will stay “scheduled” and never start.
schedule.warnPlanning: Without a date, this match goes back to “To schedule”: it won't launch until a new time is set.

ghost.full: This tournament is full: there are no slots left to take.
ghost.slotsLeft: Only {count, plural, one {# slot is} other {# slots are}} left in this tournament.
ghost.batchMax: {max} entrants at most per registration: start again for the rest.
ghost.loadFailed: List unavailable. Close and reopen the window to try again.

TEAM.title: Register a ghost team
TEAM.hint: Only for ghost teams: a team of players always registers itself.
TEAM.noneAvailable: No ghost team to register: they're all entered, or none exist yet.
TEAM.success: {count, plural, one {Ghost team registered.} other {# ghost teams registered.}}

SOLO.title: Register a guest player
SOLO.hint: Only for players without an account on the site: a registered player always enters themselves.
SOLO.noneAvailable: No guest player to register: they're all entered, or none exist yet.
SOLO.success: {count, plural, one {Guest player registered.} other {# guest players registered.}}

rollback.title: Erase {stage}
rollback.erases: Everything entered in {stage} is lost: scores, winners, match forfeits and pending reports. The matches stay in place, with the same teams, and go back to being unplayed.
rollback.repeat: This is what reopens the previous round for correction. You can repeat it: each time, the tournament goes back one round. Withdrawals and penalties already declared stay in effect.
rollback.reopen: This tournament is finished: it will be reopened. Its final standings are erased and it goes back to “in progress”. A new champion will be crowned — and announced again on Discord — once this round has been replayed.
rollback.noteScores: Note the scores below before continuing. Nothing is archived: once the round is erased, you'll have to re-enter them by hand to get back to the current state.

live.title: Match stream
live.noStartAt: No start date is set for this match: going on air at the set time needs a time first.
live.autoStop: The live stops on its own as soon as a score is entered.
live.urlHint: Leave empty to flag the match without a link. Accepted platforms: {platforms}.

replay.title: Match replay
replay.notReplayable: This match isn't (or is no longer) finished: its replay isn't shown. You can only remove the link.
replay.invalid: Link not recognized: it must be a YouTube video link (youtube.com/watch?v=…, youtu.be/… or youtube.com/live/…).
replay.hint: A “Replay available” banner will show under the match, visible to everyone.

summary.REGISTRATION: Registration opens right now, instead of {date}. Its closing and the kickoff stay at the announced dates.
summary.LOCKED: Registration closes right now, instead of {date}: no one will be able to join the tournament anymore. Kickoff stays set for {start}.
summary.RUNNING: Kickoff is brought forward to right now, instead of {date}. The draw is made from the current entrants: no one will be able to join the tournament anymore.

atStart.TEAM: {count, plural, one {Team at the start} other {Teams at the start}}
atStart.SOLO: {count, plural, one {Player at the start} other {Players at the start}}

advance.publishes: This tournament wasn't published yet: opening its registration makes it visible to everyone.
advance.empty: Fewer than two entrants: the tournament won't play any match and will close right away.
advance.emptyOne: Fewer than two entrants: the tournament won't play any match and will close right away, with the only entrant declared first.

penalty.hint: Reason required, visible to everyone. Remaining pool: {remaining}.
penalty.eliminates: Pool down to 0: {name} will be eliminated from the tournament.
penalty.applied: Penalty of {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} applied to {name}.
penalty.title: Endurance penalty
penalty.reasonPlaceholder: Late for kickoff, ineligible player fielded…

delete.title: Permanently delete this tournament
delete.body: This can't be undone. The tournament {name} will disappear from the site with all its matches, registrations and standings — including from its participants' records and stats.
delete.kept: No team or player is deleted: only this tournament's results are.
delete.label: Type the tournament's name to confirm
delete.blocked: Deletion stays blocked until the name matches.

issue.sentReferees: Report sent to {count, plural, one {# referee} other {# referees}}.
issue.title: Report a problem
issue.label: What's going on?
issue.placeholder: Opponent missing, disputed score, server problem…
issue.tooShort: Describe the problem in at least {min} characters.
issue.counter: {length}/{max} — sent to the referees on Discord.

image.title: Tournament image
image.intro: Optional. It dresses up the tournament page, the list cards and the home page — a tournament without an image keeps its usual look.
image.conflict: The image was changed elsewhere while you were adjusting it. “Save” will replace that change with yours; “Cancel” keeps it.

contacts.noPlayer: No linked player: entrant invited by the staff.
contacts.badgeTitle: Verified Discord tag: this player has proven they own this Discord account.
contacts.title: Discord contacts
contacts.intro: Referees only. Only verified tags appear: a player who hasn't proven theirs can't be reached through the site.
